scope: Primary-source research for an unexecuted GitHub Actions Apple build. No cloud service, workflow, or repository was created or run by this review.

recommended_standard_runner.label: macos-26
recommended_standard_runner.selection_reason: Explicit standard OS label avoids a future macos-latest migration; current stable image includes Xcode 26.6. Do not select xcode-27 preview or -large/-xlarge labels.
runtime_provenance_to_record: free disk before and after build
recommended_standard_runner.limits: Runner inventory changes. A reviewed image/version is not proof of the exact image used by a future job; preserve its Set up job log.

installed_inventory.ldid: Not listed in runner inventory; install explicitly if required.

additional_toolchain_advice.rust: Rust 1.99.1 is an official stable release dated 2026-10-16. Explicitly install the Linux-tested version and aarch64-apple-ios target rather than use the image default 1.99.0.
additional_toolchain_advice.rustup_command_execution: Proposed only; not run against a macOS runner.
additional_toolchain_advice.cmake: Default CMake 4.4.4 differs from the successful Linux baseline 3.31.12. This is a version-risk to inspect in existing dependency build scripts, not a demonstrated macOS failure. Do not claim brew install cmake@3 works: the official Formula/c/cmake@3.rb path returned 404 during this review.

artifact_delivery.proposal: Build and validate the IPA first; upload that single file with upload-artifact v7 archive:false and if-no-files-found:error. Upload logs/source provenance/checksums separately.
artifact_delivery.archive_false_contract: Exactly one file, uploaded as-is; artifact name is the filename and the name input is ignored.
artifact_delivery.download: Actions run summary > Artifacts; user must be signed in and have repository read access.
artifact_delivery.retention_limits: Requested duration cannot exceed repository/organization policy. Public repositories allow 1–90 days; private policy can allow 1–400 days.
artifact_delivery.permission_note: Uploading an app directory as ordinary files does not preserve executable permissions. A properly formed IPA is already an archive; preserve and hash those bytes.
artifact_delivery.success_scope: A completed upload proves that an artifact exists. It does not prove sideloading, XR memory fit, game launch, or full-playthrough behavior.

job_limits.billing_scope: Standard public-repository runners are documented as free; private-repository use consumes the account allowance and may be billed afterward. No runner or charge was started by this review.

full_playthrough_evidence_plan.status: Planned evidence requirements; no full playthrough is claimed.
full_playthrough_evidence_plan.already_observed: Linux no-JIT startup/menu, first campaign scene, existing save reload, robot-to-car transformation and one adjacent-tile move. No completed mission, combat, audible audio, Apple build or XR run is currently verified.

requirements.evidence: Actual cloud run log; pinned source/patch/dependency revisions; ARM64 iphoneos executable and deployment-target checks; final IPA SHA256; ordinary Sideloadly installation and no-JIT/compact startup on XR iOS 17.5.

Map the 30 recovered stream IDs to observed missions/shared/branch resources. Record actual mission start, objectives, victory/transition and final campaign ending. Account for all streams without assuming each is a separate story mission; no forced game-state transitions.

Exercise turns and enemy AI, close/ranged attacks and retaliation, damage/death, capture/energon, repair/upgrades, transformations, terrain/flying/pathfinding, victory, defeat and retry through original controls; record any untested branch.

New save after movement/combat and mission progress; cold-launch reload restores the expected state. Preserve before/after hashes and observed progress. Current transformation/move probes left savegame unchanged.

XR audio, touch alignment, background/foreground, interruption handling, repeated launches, long mission/campaign sessions, memory pressure and frame timing. Cloud build or Linux playback does not establish these device properties.

Keep explicit unsupported CPU/API/memory failures visible, correlate logs with recorded inputs/frames, and rerun affected sequences after fixes. Scope confidence to the tested artifact/device/routes rather than promise absence of every possible bug.
